summary: Run 39828121993 of wasm-custody-pilot.yml was the single admitted dispatch at c6dabf4 (artifact zip sha256 6c74ef80...). The independent acceptance review (FS-GG/.github#4710 comment 6347853904) returned ACCEPTED WITH GAPS. Established on GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 (kernel 7.0.0-1017-azure) with the pinned managed-group owner d846dbe1: all 16 managed groups were observed-empty-removed and contained, with no escapes or residue, admitted leader images and no_new_privs. Chromium headless-shell 1243 and Firefox 1543 (content sandbox enabled) shut down clean under the stock runner with a vite preview webServer and require-empty; Playwright's own teardown emptied the group. Browsers held past a 25 s deadline were retired by cgroup.kill. The Chromium library scan was complete for chrome-linux64 and chrome-headless-shell-linux64. Corrected claims: forced cases prove that the group held processes past SIGTERM, not which browser processes. The leader-exit case did not exercise survivor retirement: Playwright's exit handler in the leader SIGKILLs the browser process group when the leader exits, well within the 2 s settle window (leaderExitSettleSeconds), so residualAfterLeaderExit was empty. WebKit 2359 cannot start on the stock runner: Playwright's dependency check found 34 missing libraries (libgtk-4, GStreamer, libflite, libavif16, libmanette, libGLESv2.so.2, libx264), so WebKit startup and shutdown are not established. The artifact omitted hidden files, and the unit limits were not captured as unit properties. A second admitted run addresses these gaps. Not established: installed C and the 27-case journey.
title: First WASM custody pilot run qualified Chromium and Firefox custody only; WebKit lacks host libraries
